# Agent-Ready Score

> Free, open-source 0-100 score of how ready an API is for AI agents, computed from its OpenAPI document: discoverability (llms.txt, /.well-known, robots), docs quality, predictable errors (RFC 9457), auth and identity, and MCP-wrappability (tool-list token cost). Web page, CLI, GitHub Action and README badge. Pro is coming soon; there is no paid plan today. Discovery checks the API host and, since 20 November 2026, the docs site for llms.txt.

## Use it
- [Score an API](https://agent-ready-score.omer20sh.workers.dev/): paste an OpenAPI URL or document, no sign-up.
- [HTTP API](https://agent-ready-score.omer20sh.workers.dev/api/score?url=https://petstore3.swagger.io/api/v3/openapi.json): GET /api/score?url=<spec> returns JSON.
- [GitHub Action](https://github.com/Om3rr/agent-ready-score#github-action) and [CLI](https://github.com/Om3rr/agent-ready-score#cli): fail CI under a score, write a Shields badge.
- [MCP server CLI](https://github.com/Om3rr/mcp-readiness-cli): the sister tool that scans a live MCP server.

## Data
- [Leaderboard of 34 public APIs, 20 November 2026](https://agent-ready-score.omer20sh.workers.dev/scores/): scores, category breakdown and fixes per API.
- Median Agent-Ready Score across 34 well-known public APIs: 63/100 (mean 62.3).
- 1 of 34 scored 80 or more; 8 of 34 scored 70 or more.
- 32 of 34 API origins serve no /llms.txt (probed on the API host, e.g. api.example.com, not the docs site).
- 34 of 34 specs never advertise application/problem+json (RFC 9457) errors.
- 24 of 34 API origins expose no /.well-known MCP, OAuth protected-resource or API-catalog document.
- 17 of 34 specs leave most operations without request or response examples; 16 of 34 leave most operations without a documented 5xx response.
- 18 of 34 specs would produce an MCP tool list over 50,000 tokens if wrapped naively (about 4 characters per token).
- Weakest category on average: Discoverability (33/100). Strongest: Auth & identity (81/100).
